items.project_definition: The set of RESTful endpoints versioned as v1 for managing sports data and user interactions.
The cross-origin resource sharing policy implicitly required to allow browser-based clients to interact with the specified backend endpoints.
The unique identifier used to retrieve a specific sports event record.
The network address used as a key to apply a maximum of 5 requests per minute for authentication endpoints.
The lightweight data-interchange format used for all request bodies and response payloads.
The signed token passed in the Authorization header as a Bearer credential to secure non-auth endpoints.
The 128-bit universally unique format used for primary keys across all entities including matches, teams, and leagues.
The ISO string parameter serving as the lower temporal boundary for filtering sports events.
The ISO string parameter serving as the upper temporal boundary for filtering sports events.
The unique reference to a specific sports competition used to filter the list of events.
